_doc: Statistics-only confidence of the hockey / basketball / volleyball / CS2 coupon legs, fitted by scripts/sofa/fit_sport_confidence.py. A leg's confidence is the realised_lo95 of the bucket its model probability (score_model / cs2_engine) falls in, for an ADMITTED key (family|OVER/UNDER/DRAW/TEAM) only; a key in not_calibrated, a bucket absent from the curve (n < min_bucket) or a sport absent from this file is NOT_CALIBRATED. No price is an input.
